info.description: The Monticel Battery Detail Management API enables users to create and manage detailed information about Monticel battery products. This endpoint allows for the addition of new battery details to the catalog, ensuring that all relevant specifications and attributes are accurately recorded and updated. Typical consumers of this API include inventory managers and sales teams looking to maintain comprehensive product data. By employing this API, businesses can enhance their product offerings and improve data accuracy within their inventory systems.

post.description: This operation allows users to create detailed information for Monticel batteries. It processes the input data to generate a new set of battery details that can be utilized for various applications.
